finalText:
Green. 625/625, exit 0.

Root cause — `src/pricing.js:39` `orderTotal`:

```js
const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);   // taxed pre-discount base
return discounted + tax;
```

Taxed full `cents` instead of discounted amount. Fix:

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Only 3 of 625 cases had discount and tax both non-zero — rest masked bug. Other 8 suites were never broken; wall of text was passing lines plus coverage table.
